hypothesis: NHL SOG count rates or tail dispersion may be miscalibrated on genuine future prices, independently of actual ice-time exposure; first test a simple shrink/dispersion challenger, not heavy joint architecture.
source_reason: NHL Nov10 GateB verified 47 contracted skater SOG outcomes from 3 games; Brier naive 0.296334, peer 0.254484, book no-vig 0.245472. Postgame actual-TOI oracle gives only modest improvements and is never a pregame feature. This cohort is for hypothesis discovery only.
required_before_first_trial: Choose exact single challenger and lock source code revision
Record original pregame features, real quotes, role and team validity
Predeclare dispersion prior or rate shrinkage hyperparameters without using future evaluation outcomes
Freeze model training cutoff and seeds
Demonstrate nonzero prospective calendar-date accrual and settlement verification
pass_rule: No leak/provenance errors; challenger has favorable paired proper scores with uncertainty across predeclared independent prospective cohort and does not lose material coverage, calibration or role fidelity; otherwise baseline retained.
rollback: Champion and prices remain frozen, challenger remains shadow; never overwrite original forecasts or data.
